Name: 158k Arabic Facebook posts
Description: A corpus of Arabic Facebook posts spanning women's discourse and engagement metrics.
Paper Title: Learning to Engage: Modeling Topic-Sensitive Reactions in Arabic Women’s Online Discourse
Venue Name: Conference of the European Chapter of the Association for Computational Linguistics
Abstract: Predicting how audiences react to Arabic social media posts requires reasoning beyond textual sentiment: reactions emerge from collective interpretation moderated by engagement dynamics and topical context. We present a multi-task learning framework that jointly learns (i) audience reaction classification (Love, Haha, Angry, Sad, Care, Wow), (ii) engagement magnitude regression (six reactions, comments, shares), and (iii) non-engagement detection. On a corpus of 158k Arabic Facebook posts spanning women’s rights, gender debates, and economic empowerment, our model achieves a test macro-F1 of 72.4 and weighted-F1 of 89.1.
